places.name: Restaurant Husar
places.near: Fürstenstraße in the Partenkirchen half, ~5 min drive from the centre; on-street/side-street parking
places.order: Seasonal fish course (char/pike-perch from local lakes), beef fillet or venison with Werdenfels sides (no-pork), vegetarian tasting dishes; ask for the day's menu
places.famousFor: 400-year-old inn run by the Merget family since 1986; MICHELIN Guide-listed (€€€) with charming wood-panelled Stüberl and a terrace facing the Wetterstein range
places.goodToKnow: Dinner only, Tue–Sat 18:00–22:30 per the MICHELIN Guide (closed Sun & Mon); some directories list Sun lunch + Sat closed, so call +49 8821 9677922 to confirm your day. ~€45–75/person à la carte. Reservation strongly recommended. Smart-casual; fine for well-behaved kids but no kids' menu. Open year-round – mid-Oct 2026 is normal season.

places.name: Joseph Naus Stub'n (Hotel Zugspitze)
places.near: Klammstraße 19 in central Garmisch, 3 min from the pedestrian zone; hotel car park
places.order: Lake char or whitefish from Upper Bavarian/Tyrolean lakes, Rindfleischpflanzerl (beef patties, ~€25) from Utzschneider farm, vegetarian versions of any dish (no vegan); 'Bib Gourmand' 3-course menu ~€50
places.famousFor: MICHELIN Guide-listed (€€) hotel restaurant named after the first Zugspitze summiteer; chef Georg Strohmeyer's creative farm-to-table cooking with produce from Ohlstadt, Oberammergau butcher and Bavarian lake fish
places.goodToKnow: Stub'n serves dinner only, daily 18:00–20:30 (kitchen) incl. Sun; lunch 12:00–14:00 is in the sister Zugspitz Stad'l (2-course lunch menu). Kids' menu available. ~€35–60/person. Online/phone reservation +49 8821 9010. Open year-round – fine for 15–17 Oct 2026.

places.name: Gasthof Fraundorfer
places.near: Ludwigstraße 24 in Partenkirchen; short walk from the Ludwigstraße/Bahnhofstraße parking areas
places.order: Wiener Schnitzel (veal), Kässpätzle, trout/char from the region, Kaiserschmarrn; plenty of beef/veg alternatives to the pork roasts
places.famousFor: Partenkirchen's most famous Gasthof on the painted Ludwigstraße – nightly live Bavarian music, Schuhplattler dancing and yodelling in a 1820s inn; a tourist institution
places.goodToKnow: Restaurant open Thu–Mon 17:00–23:00 (kitchen until 21:00); CLOSED Tue & Wed – Thu 15 and Fri 16 Oct 2026 are fine. Loud, festive, very family-friendly (kids love the dancing); high chairs. ~€20–35/person. Book ahead – it fills nightly. Cards accepted.

places.name: Zum Wildschütz
places.near: Bankgasse 9, a side street off the Garmisch centre; free parking directly outside (rare in town)
places.order: Wildgulasch (game), Schnitzel, tapas-style Brotzeit boards, Kaiserschmarrn; vegetarian Kässpätzle and salads; game and schnitzel are pork-free options
places.famousFor: Multi-award-winning 'gut bürgerlich' Bavarian kitchen specialising in game (Wildgulasch, venison) from the Werdenfels forests; 90 seats inside + 70-seat beer garden; Hacker-Pschorr beer
places.goodToKnow: Wed from 17:00, Thu–Sun from 12:00, warm kitchen until 21:00; closed Mon & Tue. ~€18–35/person. Reservations by phone only (+49 8821 3290). Casual and child-friendly. Open year-round.

places.name: Restaurant Vaun
places.near: Zugspitzstraße 2 at the west end of the Garmisch pedestrian zone, near the Kurpark; nearby public parking
places.order: Seasonal tasting menu or à la carte: regional lake fish, dry-aged local beef, vegetable-forward vegetarian courses (very veg-friendly)
places.famousFor: Garmisch's creative modern-Alpine address – every ingredient from named farms and small producers around the Werdenfelser Land; also runs a lunchtime food truck in Kemmelpark
places.goodToKnow: Dinner only Tue–Sat 17:30–22:30 (one directory also lists Mon); CLOSED Sun. ~€40–65/person. Small room – reserve (+49 8821 7308187). Better suited to the adults and teens than the 4-year-old.

places.name: Ristorante Pizzeria Colosseo
places.near: Klammstraße 7 next to Hotel Zugspitze, central Garmisch
places.order: Pizza Frutti di Mare or Margherita, grilled fish of the day, pasta al pomodoro for the kids, tiramisu (pork-free toppings easy to pick)
places.famousFor: The town's go-to family Italian for 30+ years – wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta and daily specials; also delivers
places.goodToKnow: Daily 11:30–14:30 & 17:00–22:00, no closing day. ~€15–28/person. Very kid-friendly, high chairs; online table reservation. Handy Thursday-arrival dinner (late kitchen). Open year-round.

places.name: Gasthof zum Rassen
places.near: Ludwigstraße 45, Partenkirchen; parking on the street or at the Rathausplatz
places.order: Schnitzel with potato salad, Kässpätzle, potato soup, Kaiserschmarrn (Schweinshaxe is the local favourite but pork); trout when offered
places.famousFor: Historic 1600s inn on Ludwigstraße housing Bavaria's oldest farmers' theatre (Bauerntheater Partenkirchen); classic Bavarian dishes all day and Werdenfelser beer
places.goodToKnow: Open daily 07:30–22:00, warm kitchen all day, no closing day. ~€15–30/person. Included as the landmark address on the painted street – reviews are mixed (Tripadvisor 3.1, 169 reviews, service can be slow when busy), so treat as atmosphere-first. Family-friendly, high chairs.

places.name: Gasthof Werdenfelser Hof
places.near: Ludwigstraße 58, upper end of Partenkirchen's old street; side-street parking
places.order: Werdenfelser lamb dishes (roast lamb, lamb shank), Wiener Schnitzel, Kässpätzle, seasonal salads – lamb and veal make it easy to skip pork
places.famousFor: Centuries-old Ludwigstraße inn (King Ludwig II stopped here) known for Werdenfelser lamb from the family's own flock, a rustic beer hall and the historic Schäfflersaal
places.goodToKnow: Tue–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat & Sun 11:00–23:00; CLOSED Mon. ~€18–35/person. Seats 140 + beer garden – good for a party of 7; occasional live Bavarian music. Reserve at +49 8821 3621.

places.name: Gasthaus zur Schranne
places.near: Griesstraße 4, 2 min from Marienplatz/Mohrenplatz in the Garmisch centre
places.order: Rahmschwammerl (creamy mushrooms) with dumplings, Zwiebelrostbraten (beef), lake fish of the day, Kässpätzle, apple strudel
places.famousFor: Half-timbered 'Traditionslokal' in the Garmisch old town serving authentic alpine-Bavarian cooking with regional suppliers and Augustiner beer; strong vegetarian choice for a Wirtshaus
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Fri from 11:00, Sat/Sun/holidays from 10:00, kitchen until 21:00 (some listings show Mon closed – check). ~€18–32/person. Family-friendly, beer garden. Reservation +49 8821 9098030.

places.name: Fischer's Mohrenplatz Wirtshaus & Biergarten
places.near: Mohrenplatz 4 in the heart of Garmisch's pedestrian zone; public parking at the Kongresshaus/Kurpark
places.order: Schnitzel, Zwiebelrostbraten, Kässpätzle, seasonal fish, big Brotzeit boards; children's portions
places.famousFor: Big, lively Wirtshaus with the town's best-known beer garden right on Mohrenplatz; no-frills seasonal Bavarian cooking from regional produce
places.goodToKnow: Open daily from 11:30 (approx. to 22:00), no closing day. ~€15–30/person. Large capacity, very family-friendly, high chairs; beer garden weather-dependent in October. Reservation +49 8821 732277-0.

places.name: Restaurant Bagram
places.near: Von-Brug-Straße 12 near the Garmisch centre; large public parking garage directly opposite (check height for the van), limited on-site
places.order: Kabuli Palau (lamb rice), Ghormeh Köfte, smoked BBQ beef, mantu dumplings, vegetarian aushak and lentil dishes; all halal
places.famousFor: Garmisch's top-rated restaurant on Google (4.9 from 570+ reviews) – authentic Afghan kitchen (kabuli palau, mantu, aushak) fused with smoked BBQ; fully halal-certified
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 11:30–22:30 (lunch specials Mon–Fri 12–14), CLOSED Sun. ~€15–28/person. Halal certified, vegetarian options, family gatherings welcome, outdoor seating. Cash-only per several reviewers – bring euros. Open year-round.

places.name: Panorama 2962 (Zugspitze summit)
places.near: Seilbahn Zugspitze from Eibsee (Am Eibsee 6, Grainau) or Zahnradbahn + Gletscherbahn; restaurant is at the summit station; Eibsee car park (van OK, paid)
places.order: Tyrolean Kasspatzln, Swiss rösti with alpine cheese, Italian pasta, Bavarian Kaiserschmarrn; soups and salads; vegetarian plates clearly marked
places.famousFor: Germany's highest restaurant at 2,962 m on the summit terrace – 360° view of ~400 peaks in four countries; menu themed on Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy with organic/fair-trade produce
places.goodToKnow: Daily 09:00–16:00, hot food 11:00–15:00; open year-round during cable-car hours (Sept–June cable car 08:30–16:45, last ascent 30 min before). 450 seats inside + 850 outside – no reservation needed for lunch. ~€15–25/person; self-service style. Combine with Sonnalpin/Gletscher 2600 on the Zugspitzplatt. Gipfelalm on the Austrian side of the summit is a separate option.

places.name: Gletscherrestaurant Sonnalpin
places.near: Zahnradbahn from Garmisch/Eibsee to Zugspitzplatt, or Gletscherbahn down from the summit (4 min, every 10 min)
places.order: Daily specials, Weisswurst-free Bavarian plates (Kässpätzle, goulash soup, Schnitzel), pasta for kids, cakes; vegetarian options marked
places.famousFor: Big glacier restaurant at 2,600 m on the Zugspitzplatt next to the Gletschergarten and Zahnradbahn terminus; sun terrace over the Schneeferner glacier
places.goodToKnow: Daily 08:30–16:00, hot food 11:00–15:00, year-round. Self-service, 290 seats inside + 500 outside, kids' portions. ~€12–20/person. Sister spot Gletscher 2600 (115 seats, table service) is next door. Zahnradbahn valley section has rail-replacement bus 09–13 Nov & 16–20 Nov 2026 – not affecting 15–17 Oct.

places.name: Osterfelder 2000 (Alpspitzbahn top station)
places.near: Alpspitzbahn from the Kreuzeck/Alpspitz valley station (Am Kreuzeckbahnhof, Garmisch); large valley car park suitable for a van
places.order: Spinach Spätzle, creamy mushrooms with dumplings, Vinschgerl sandwiches, Kaiserschmarrn, homemade cakes; vegetarian-friendly
places.famousFor: Cosy hut-restaurant at 2,050 m beside the AlpspiX glass viewing platform – homemade alpine dishes with and without meat, South Tyrolean touches (Vinschgerl, spinach Spätzle)
places.goodToKnow: Daily 09:00–16:00 during Alpspitzbahn hours (October: 08:30–17:00); year-round except lift maintenance from 9 Nov 2026 to ski-season start – so OPEN on 16 Oct 2026. Only 55 seats inside + ~80 terrace; ~€12–20/person. Note: Drehmöser 9, Garmischer Haus and Kandahar 2 on the Hausberg are WINTER-ONLY (Hausbergbahn closed until ski season).

places.name: Restaurant Werdenfels (Das Badersee Hotel)
places.near: Am Badersee 1-5 in Untergrainau, 6 km from Garmisch; hotel car park (open air)
places.order: Lake fish (char/trout), beef roast, vegetarian mains and a large salad buffet at lunch; Kaiserschmarrn
places.famousFor: Panoramic hotel restaurant on the emerald Badersee lake with the Zugspitze massif in the window; Bavarian and international cooking from regional, seasonal produce
places.goodToKnow: Lunch buffet 12:00–13:30 (depends on occupancy), snacks 12:00–18:00, dinner 18:00–20:30, open daily; one directory lists Mon–Sat 18–21 / Sun closed for the à-la-carte evening – reserve via the website or +49 8821 821-0 to be safe. External guests welcome. ~€25–45/person. Family-friendly 4-star hotel (kids' facilities, high chairs). Open year-round.

places.name: Alpenhof Grainau (Hotel-Restaurant)
places.near: Alpspitzstraße 34 in Obergrainau, 10 min from Garmisch; hotel parking
places.order: Fish of the day, veal or beef from Haller, vegetarian seasonal plates, dessert buffet on gala nights
places.famousFor: One of Grainau's best hotel kitchens – lighter takes on Bavarian classics with meat from the award-winning Haller butcher (since 1896); themed candle-light evenings and music nights
places.goodToKnow: Dinner 18:00–20:00 daily (closed midday; coffee & cake 14–18). External guests welcome but RESERVATION REQUIRED (+49 8821 9870). ~€30–50/person. Quiet, better for a calmer family dinner. Open year-round.

places.name: Berggasthof Panorama – Restaurant Bella Vista
places.near: St.-Anton 3 – drive up the St.-Anton road from Partenkirchen (narrow, fine for a van) ; free parking; 10 min from the A95
places.order: Pizza, pasta, grilled fish, beef tagliata, tiramisu; easy vegetarian options
places.famousFor: The best terrace view in town – the Berggasthof sits on the St.-Anton hill above Partenkirchen looking over the whole valley to the Zugspitze; now runs as the Italian 'Bella Vista'
places.goodToKnow: Tue–Fri 11:30–14:30 & 17:00–22:00, Sat & Sun 11:30–22:00, CLOSED Mon (Tripadvisor listing; older directories show Wed–Sun 9–18 – call +49 8821 9669070). ~€18–35/person. Rated 3.8 (100 reviews): go for the view and pizza rather than fine food. 160 seats + 150 terrace, family-friendly.

places.name: Hotel-Gasthof Alter Wirt Farchant
places.near: Bahnhofstraße 1-3 in Farchant, on the B2 just before Garmisch; own car park
places.order: Roast beef with onions, schnitzel, seasonal fish, Kässpätzle, homemade strudel
places.famousFor: Village inn 4 km north of Garmisch praised for 'handmade' cooking from a neighbouring baker and small butcher, Franconian/South Tyrolean wines and a shady beer garden
places.goodToKnow: Warm kitchen Tue–Sat 17:00–21:00, Sun 11:00–14:00 & 17:00–21:00; CLOSED Mon & Thu (so Fri 16 Oct works, Thu 15 does not). ~€18–32/person. Family-run, kids welcome. Reserve +49 8821 96700 70.

places.name: Alpenhof Murnau – Panorama-Restaurant
places.near: Ramsachstraße 8, Murnau – 25 min north of Garmisch on the A95/B2; hotel car park
places.order: Monkfish or lake fish course, Nebraska beef, multi-course seasonal menu (3–7 courses), vegetarian menu on request
places.famousFor: Long-standing gourmet hotel above Murnau (Blaues Land) – chef Claus Gromotka's refined Bavarian-international cuisine, a wine list ranked among Germany's best (sommelier Domenico Durante) and full alpine panorama
places.goodToKnow: Dinner Tue–Sat 18:30–21:30; CLOSED Sun & Mon. À la carte for outside guests; ~€60–110/person for menus. Reservation essential (+49 8841 4910). Elegant – best for the adults/teens; a worthwhile detour on the Thursday if arriving via Munich side, otherwise 25 min from the house.

places.name: Das Marktrestaurant
places.cuisine: Refined Bavarian tavern cuisine (1 Michelin star)
places.near: Dekan-Karl-Platz 21 in Mittenwald's old centre, 20 min from Garmisch; public car parks at the edge of the pedestrian zone
places.order: 'Wirtshaus mal anders' tasting menu (also in a full vegetarian version), sharing menu; fish and beef courses – tell them no pork when booking
places.famousFor: Andreas Hillejan's one-MICHELIN-star restaurant (since 2017) in a painted house on Mittenwald's market square – 'Wirtshaus mal anders' menus that elevate Bavarian inn classics; JRE member, Falstaff/Feinschmecker-listed
places.goodToKnow: Dinner from 18:30, Tue–Sat per its own website (MICHELIN lists Wed–Sat 18:30–23:00); CLOSED Sun & Mon. Menus ~€90–140/person. Reserve online or +49 8823 9269595. Relaxed for a starred place but multi-course – suited to the adults and older kids.

places.name: Traditionsgasthof Alpenrose
places.near: Obermarkt 1, at the church end of Mittenwald's main street; car parks on the ring road
places.order: Crispy Schweinshaxe is the signature (pork) – choose instead Wiener Schnitzel, Schwäbische Kässpätzle (€14.80), Salat Alpenrose, trout, Kaiserschmarrn
places.famousFor: Mittenwald's classic painted-façade Gasthof on Obermarkt with daily zither/live music from 19:00, horse-carriage rides and hearty Bavarian portions; open all day, every day
places.goodToKnow: Open daily year-round, NO closing day; full menu 11:30–13:45 & 17:00–20:45, reduced warm menu 11:00–20:45. ~€15–28/person. Very family-friendly, OpenTable bookings, cards OK.

places.name: Brauereigaststätte Postkeller
places.near: Innsbrucker Straße 13 on the south side of Mittenwald; own parking
places.order: Brauhausburger (beef), Kässpätzle with roasted onions, Schnitzel, fish of the week; Weisswurst breakfast is pork (skip)
places.famousFor: Big brewhouse of the Mittenwalder Brauerei – authentic beer-hall cooking, Brauhausburger and Kässpätzle under new owners since Dec 2024; 250 seats, lift, huge beer garden
places.goodToKnow: 11:30–22:00, warm kitchen until 20:00; directories list Wed & Thu as closing days outside high season – so Fri 16 Oct is safe, confirm at +49 8823 9379480. ~€15–28/person. Excellent for a group of 7, high chairs, wheelchair/lift access.

places.name: Alpengasthof Gröbl-Alm
places.near: Gröblalm 2, signposted road up from the B2 north of Mittenwald; large car park (coach-friendly)
places.order: Roast beef with dumplings, Kässpätzle, fresh trout, homemade cakes and strudel; kids' dishes
places.famousFor: Panorama inn on the hill above Mittenwald with the full Karwendel/Wetterstein view, all-day warm kitchen and cakes from its own bakery; family-run for generations
places.goodToKnow: Summer season 2 Apr–25 Oct 2026, daily until 22:00, warm kitchen 11:30–20:30 (short break 17:00–17:30); NO closing day – OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026, then closed 26 Oct–18 Dec. ~€15–28/person. Terrace with playground feel, very family-friendly.

places.name: Gasthof Zur Post Wallgau
places.near: Dorfplatz 6, Wallgau – 25 min from Garmisch via Krün; parking on the square
places.order: Schnitzel, roast beef, Kässpätzle, seasonal venison, Kaiserschmarrn
places.famousFor: Village-square Gasthof in pretty Wallgau (painted houses, Isar valley) known for honest Bavarian cooking and a big beer garden – a favourite with locals and cyclists
places.goodToKnow: Gasthaus 10:00–23:00, kitchen 11:30–14:00 & 17:30–21:00 (small menu in between); CLOSED Mon (some listings also Tue). Winter break from 1 Nov 2026 – open in mid-October. ~€15–28/person. High-season dinner seatings at 18:00 or 19:45; no beer-garden reservations.

places.name: IKIGAI (Schloss Elmau)
places.near: Schloss Elmau, private valley road from Klais (between Garmisch and Mittenwald), 20 min from the house; hotel parking
places.order: Two fixed tasting menus (one fully vegetarian); French technique with Japanese ingredients – fish and wagyu/beef courses, no pork issue on request
places.famousFor: Christoph Rainer's two-MICHELIN-star, 19-point Gault&Millau restaurant inside the G7-summit castle hotel Schloss Elmau – the region's top table
places.goodToKnow: Wed–Sat 19:00–21:00 only; closed Sun–Tue. External guests book via OpenTable – ~€275/person menu. Adults/teens only in practice (long menu, hushed room). Special-occasion choice for the two adults; the hotel's other restaurants are for residents.

places.name: Ammergauer Maxbräu (Hotel Maximilian)
places.near: Ettaler Straße 5 on the main road into Oberammergau from Ettal; hotel car park
places.order: Beef goulash, Schnitzel, Kässpätzle, trout, Maxbräu burger; house-brewed unfiltered beers
places.famousFor: Oberammergau's own craft brewery-restaurant with copper kettles in the room, straightforward regional cooking and a beer garden; 100 seats inside + 100 terrace
places.goodToKnow: Tue–Thu 16:00–22:00, Fri 14:00–22:00, Sat & Sun 12:30–22:00; CLOSED Mon. ~€15–28/person. Family-friendly, casual. Reservation +49 8822 9487460.

places.name: Klosterhotel Ettal – Ludwig der Bayer
places.near: Kaiser-Ludwig-Platz 10-12 at Ettal Abbey, 15 min from Garmisch on the way to Oberammergau/Linderhof; free on-site parking incl. bus/van bays
places.order: Schnitzel, roast beef with dumplings, Kässpätzle, fresh trout, Kaiserschmarrn, children's plates
places.famousFor: The Benedictine monastery's own hotel and Bräustüberl directly opposite Ettal Abbey – hearty Bavarian dishes with Ettaler Klosterbier and monastery products; 275 seats, beer garden, playground
places.goodToKnow: Warm kitchen daily 11:30–20:30 (small menu 14:30–17:30), no closing day; Café 1330 Wed–Sun 10–17. ~€15–28/person. Family-friendly: playground, high chairs, changing room. Open year-round – ideal lunch when visiting Ettal/Linderhof.

places.name: Hotel & Restaurant Alte Post
places.near: Dorfstraße 19 on the Dorfplatz; own parking incl. EV charging
places.order: Zwiebelrostbraten (beef, ~€30), Wiener Schnitzel, Allgäuer Kässpätzle, seasonal fish; mains €12.50–30.90
places.famousFor: Historic coaching inn on Oberammergau's village square (17th-century painted ceiling) – regional Bavarian classics served all day in five traditional rooms and a 100-seat sun terrace
places.goodToKnow: Warm kitchen daily 11:30–21:00 (to 22:00 in summer), NO closing day. ~€18–35/person. 250 seats, casual and family-friendly. Open year-round.

places.name: Restaurant Uhrmacher (Landhotel Böld)
places.near: König-Ludwig-Straße 10, Oberammergau; hotel car park
places.order: Wiener Schnitzel of veal loin (€28.80), braised beef cheeks with horseradish (€26.50), osso buco, vegetarian seasonal plates
places.famousFor: Landhotel Böld's ambitious kitchen – 'fresh cuisine at a fine level' from seasonal regional produce, with a curated wine programme and Green Sign sustainability certificate
places.goodToKnow: Warm kitchen 17:30–21:00; CLOSED Tue & Wed (Thu 15 & Fri 16 Oct OK). Mains €14.50–29.20, ~€30–50/person. Reservation +49 8822 9120. Lunch only for groups of 20+.

places.name: Louis II. (Hotel Das Rübezahl)
places.near: Am Ehberg 31, Schwangau-Horn – 5 min from the Hohenschwangau car parks; hotel parking
places.order: Pan-fried Saibling (char) fillet €34, beef fillet with chanterelle cream €44, dry-aged rib-eye for two, chanterelle risotto €23 (veg), potato rösti €19 (veg)
places.famousFor: Award-winning restaurant (MICHELIN Guide & Gault&Millau) of the Rübezahl boutique spa hotel with a panoramic terrace looking straight at Neuschwanstein; chef Erik Wendt's cosmopolitan-regional plates
places.goodToKnow: Open daily (1 Apr 2026–4 Apr 2027): lunch 12:00–14:00, coffee & small menu 14:30–16:30, dinner 18:00–21:00; external guests welcome, evening reservation strongly recommended (TheFork/phone +49 8362 8888). ~€35–70/person. Best castle-view lunch on Sat 17 Oct after the 11:40 tour; family already has the hotel saved.

places.name: Schlossrestaurant Neuschwanstein
places.near: Neuschwansteinstraße 17 on the castle road – no car access; walk up (~30 min) or shuttle bus/carriage from the Hohenschwangau car parks (P4 for large vehicles)
places.order: Kässpätzle, Schnitzel, beef goulash, trout, salads, Kaiserschmarrn; kids' plates
places.famousFor: The only restaurant up at the castle – 200 seats inside plus 200 on terraces with a direct view of Neuschwanstein, a few minutes' walk below the entrance
places.goodToKnow: Daily 09:00–18:00 (summer) / 10:00–17:00 (winter hours in the off-season); closed only 24–25 Dec & 31 Dec–1 Jan. ~€15–28/person; online booking available; a quick Bistro is attached. Convenient right after the 11:40 tour before driving to Zurich.

places.name: Schloss Bräustüberl Hohenschwangau
places.near: Alpseestraße 25, Hohenschwangau, next to the castle ticket centre; use the Hohenschwangau public car parks
places.order: Allgäuer Kässpätzle, Schnitzel, beef roast, Brotzeit boards (ask for pork-free), Kaiserschmarrn
places.famousFor: Near-century-old Bavarian inn 100 m from the Alpsee at the foot of both castles (AMERON resort) – meat from Landmetzgerei Baur, cheese from Allgäu dairies, König Ludwig castle-brewery beer
places.goodToKnow: Daily 11:30–21:00, kitchen until 20:00, no closing day. ~€15–30/person. Large capacity – good fallback for 7 on a busy castle Saturday; reservation +49 8362 70300.

places.name: Alpenrose am See
places.near: Alpseestraße 21–27 on the Alpsee shore, 5 min walk from the Hohenschwangau car parks
places.order: Laugenburger (choose the veggie/vegan gyros or chicken versions – the pulled-pork one is pork), salads, cakes, König Ludwig beer/lemonade
places.famousFor: Terrace directly on the Alpsee with 'arguably the most beautiful view' of the lake and mountains below Hohenschwangau Castle (AMERON group)
places.goodToKnow: AMERON now runs it as a weather-dependent terrace/self-service café 11:30–18:00 in fine weather; older directory hours show 11:00–22:00 with Tue closed. In mid-October treat it as a sunny-day lunch/coffee stop only and check the day before (+49 8362 70300). ~€12–25/person.

places.name: Restaurant Ritterstuben
places.near: Ritterstraße 4 in the pedestrianised old town; park at the Füssen multi-storey or Morisse car park and walk 5 min
places.order: Wiener Schnitzel, roast beef, Kässpätzle, trout, gluten-free Kaiserschmarrn
places.famousFor: Since 1995 in one of Füssen's oldest houses below the Hohes Schloss – classic Bavarian dishes with an unusually complete gluten-free menu; cosy 'knights' parlour' rooms
places.goodToKnow: Tue–Sun 11:30–21:30; CLOSED Mon (Sat 17 Oct OK). ~€18–32/person. Small – reserve for 7 (+49 8362 7759). Note the prompt's 'Ristorante Ritterstub'n' is this Bavarian house, not an Italian.

places.name: Madame Plüsch
places.near: Drehergasse 48 in the old town, 3 min from the Reichenstraße; old-town car parks
places.order: Bunte Saisonsalatplatte (€19.90), Kässpätzle sharing pan, roast beef, seasonal fish; ask for pork-free platters
places.famousFor: Füssen's most-talked-about restaurant – a plush 'Golden Twenties' nostalgia room, sharing platters of Spätzle and sauerkraut, and consistently top ratings on Yelp/Tripadvisor
places.goodToKnow: Thu–Mon 12:00–16:00 & 17:00–23:00 (kitchen 17–21); CLOSED Tue & Wed. No lunch reservations (walk-in), dinner reservations by phone +49 8362 9300949. ~€20–35/person. Family-friendly, terrace, cards OK. Historic October holiday closures were noted in past years – confirm it is open 17 Oct 2026.

places.name: Zum Hechten (Altstadthotel)
places.near: Ritterstraße 6 in the pedestrian old town next to Ritterstuben; old-town car parks
places.order: Kaiserschmarrn, Schnitzel, Allgäuer Kässpätzle, trout; (Schweinshaxe is pork)

Pork on buffet; egg/fish/veg options; not halal-certified.

Good Sat 17 Oct early option (07:00 start, 15 min to Hohenschwangau car parks). Pork items present but separate; eggs/fish/veg/cheese plentiful; not halal-certified.

Breakfasts EUR 5.90-10.90; cold cuts contain pork - swap for cheese/egg/salmon; not halal-certified. Family-friendly. Tel +49 8362 8220.

places.name: Das Lokal - Café im Bahnhof Mittenwald

places.name: Bäckerei Aurhammer

places.goodToKnow: Mon 06:00-13:00, Tue-Fri 06:00-17:00, Sat 06:00-12:00, Sun/holidays 07:00-10:00 -> Sat 17 Oct only until 12:00. Cheap (EUR 3-9). Sausage rolls contain pork - choose cheese/sweet; not halal-certified. Family-friendly; fuller breakfast café at their Unterammergau branch. Tel +49 8822 3521.

Egg/veg/fish dishes plentiful, pork avoidable; not halal-certified. EUR 9-16. Family-friendly. Tel +49 8362 9262727.

places.name: Kaffeehaus & Konditorei Krönner

Cakes, ice cream, hot dishes; vegetarian and egg options easy; not halal-certified (menu has pork dishes, ask). Prices moderate (cake ~EUR 5-7). Family-friendly, large room, high chairs; can get busy 15:00-17:00. Tel +49 8821 3007.

places.name: Café Wildkaffee (Bahnhofstraße)

Coffee, cakes, sandwiches/muesli; vegetarian easy; no pork focus but not halal-certified. Prices EUR 3.50-5.50 per coffee. Small, urban; fine for kids but no play area. Tel +49 8821 7088654.

places.name: Mukkefuck Café-Bistro

Vegetarian/cheese/egg options; ham on standard breakfast (ask for cheese-only); not halal-certified. Cheap (EUR 5-12). Casual, kids OK by day; becomes a bar in the evening. Tel +49 8821 73440.

places.name: Kaffeehaus Konditorei Thron

places.name: Der Laden - Café

places.name: Eibsee Pavillon (Seerestaurant am Eibsee)

places.notes: Source: eibsee.de/eibsee-pavillon (address, kitchen, parking), gastroguide.de (hours/season). Coords left blank - no house-number match found

places.goodToKnow: Season roughly April-end October, daily 10:00-18:00 (gastroguide) - should be open 15-17 Oct 2026 but confirm by phone +49 8821 8913 before driving out. Cakes, coffee, Bavarian classics, fish; vegetarian easy; not halal-certified. Mid-range (cake EUR 5-6, mains EUR 18-30). Very family-friendly (lake path, boats in season, playground nearby). Combine with Zugspitze cable car.

places.name: Alpen Bäck - Bäckerei & Café Grainau

places.name: Kaffeehaus & Konditorei Kranzbach
places.cuisine: Traditional coffee house with own Konditorei and 120-seat garden

places.famousFor: Family-run (Kriner-Bongardt) Kaffeehaus in Krün between Garmisch and Mittenwald, famous for homemade tortes, strudels and a big garden looking at the Karwendel; classic afternoon stop on the Mittenwald/Walchensee road
places.goodToKnow: Wed-Mon 09:00-17:30, Tue CLOSED -> open Thu 15, Fri 16, Sat 17 Oct. Cakes, coffee, light lunch; vegetarian easy; not halal-certified. Moderate (cake EUR 4-6). Very family-friendly (garden, space for 7). Tel +49 8825 331.

places.name: BSONDERS & GUAD - Konditorei & Kaffeehaus

places.order: Signature torte or Baumkuchen with a cappuccino; pralines and Urkorn bread to take away
places.famousFor: Mittenwald's showpiece patisserie on the painted Obermarkt: handmade tortes, pralines and ancient-grain bakes from the Zunterer family; cosy café upstairs from the Fasl-Beck bakery
places.goodToKnow: Website: Mon-Sat 10:00-17:00; Instagram: Wed-Sun 10:00-18:00 - hours differ, confirm +49 8823 9369100. Cakes, coffee, no pork focus (bakery items may contain pork sausage - ask); not halal-certified. Moderate. Family-friendly; the same building's Fasl-Beck bakery below opens at 06:00.

places.name: Café 1330 - Kloster Ettal

places.notes: Source: klosterhotel-ettal.de/kulinarik/cafe-1330 (hours, cash), kloster-ettal.de (shop hours); Nominatim (coords = abbey complex)
places.famousFor: Café in the inner courtyard of Ettal Abbey (founded 1330) run by the Klosterhotel Ludwig der Bayer; homemade tortes, fruit strudels with vanilla sauce and monastery ice cream after visiting the baroque basilica and Klosterladen
places.goodToKnow: Tue-Sun 10:00-17:30, Mon CLOSED -> open Thu-Sat 15-17 Oct. CASH ONLY. Klosterladen Mon-Sat 09:30-17:00, Sun 13:30-17:00. Cakes, strudel, ice cream, coffee; vegetarian by nature; not halal-certified (Klosterhotel restaurant serves pork). Moderate. Family-friendly courtyard.

places.name: Café Hochenleitner
places.cuisine: Café-Konditorei with sun terrace; famous Baumkuchentorte
places.near: Faistenmantlgasse in Oberammergau, 20 km / 25 min from Garmisch via Ettal; village car parks (P1 Ammergauer Haus)
places.order: Baumkuchentorte with coffee; house pralines; ice cream for the kids
places.famousFor: Quiet Oberammergau café-confectionery 5 minutes from the centre, everything (tortes, pastries, pralines, ice cream) made in-house; the Baumkuchentorte is the local specialty and a Tripadvisor favourite
places.goodToKnow: Tue-Sun 12:00-18:00, Mon CLOSED -> afternoons only on Thu-Sat 15-17 Oct. Cakes, pralines, ice cream, coffee; vegetarian; not halal-certified. Moderate. Sun terrace, family-friendly. Tel +49 8822 1312.

places.name: Barbara Krönner Konditorei & Kaffeehaus (Oberammergau)
places.cuisine: Konditorei, Kaffeehaus and chocolaterie (Krönner family, Murnau)

places.famousFor: Oberammergau branch of the Krönner confectioner family (chocolate manufactory in Murnau); handmade pralines, truffles and tortes on the Dorfstraße right by the Passion Play village centre
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00, Sun 10:00-18:00 (gastroguide). Cakes, chocolates, coffee; vegetarian; not halal-certified. Moderate. Family-friendly. Tel +49 8842 9493653.

places.name: Barbara Krönner Konditorei & Kaffeehaus (Murnau)
places.cuisine: Traditional Kaffeehaus, Konditorei and chocolate manufactory

places.famousFor: The Krönner family's flagship coffee house on Murnau's Obermarkt: display case of tortes and pralines, own Schokoladenmanufaktur (Seidlstraße 4), classic Bavarian coffee-house atmosphere in the Blaues Land painters' town
places.goodToKnow: Daily 09:00-18:30 (oeffnungszeitenbuch) - open all three trip days. Cakes, coffee, chocolates; vegetarian; not halal-certified. Moderate. Family-friendly. Tel +49 8841 1272.

places.name: Murnauer Kaffeerösterei - Kaffeehaus
places.cuisine: Direct-trade specialty coffee roastery with tasting café
places.near: Am Mösl 4 on the south edge of Murnau (industrial/trade area), 25 km from Garmisch; parking on site
places.order: Espresso flight or a pour-over of the current Ethiopian; cake of the day; take home freshly roasted beans
places.famousFor: Thomas Eckel's roastery buys directly from farms in Ethiopia, Brazil, India; the Kaffeehaus at the roastery serves single-origin espresso and filter plus homemade cakes; supplies the Biohotel Garmischer Hof; 4.4/5
places.goodToKnow: LIMITED HOURS: Tue-Fri 13:00-17:00, Sat 10:00-17:00; Sun, Mon and holidays CLOSED -> Thu/Fri 15-16 Oct afternoons or Sat 17 Oct from 10:00. Coffee, cakes; vegetarian; no pork on site. Moderate. Kids OK but it is a roastery-café, not a play space. Tel +49 8841 4895033.

places.name: Füssener Kaffeerösterei
places.cuisine: In-house coffee roastery with café in the old town

places.famousFor: Füssen's own roastery in the historic Altstadt: ~10 freshly roasted varieties (some organic), live roasting you can watch, cosy first-floor café and outdoor tables; 4.5/5 from ~390 reviews
places.goodToKnow: Mon-Sat 09:00-18:00, Sun CLOSED -> ideal for Sat 17 Oct after the 11:40 Neuschwanstein slot. Coffee, cakes, sweets; vegetarian; not halal-certified. Coffee EUR 3-5. Family-friendly, small.

places.name: Bio Café Baumgarten
