places.near: Magnusplatz at the top of Füssen's old town, 3 min walk from Reichenstraße; park at Parkhaus Sparkasse / P3
places.order: Savoury vegetarian crêpe or a sweet Nutella/apple crêpe; vegan cake with an oat-milk cappuccino
places.famousFor: Cosy organic café on Magnusplatz by the Hohes Schloss: sweet and savoury crêpes, vegan and gluten-free cakes, good coffee; relaxed spot for a mixed-diet family in Füssen
places.goodToKnow: Daily 09:00-18:00 (allesoffen/11880) - open Sat 17 Oct. Vegetarian/vegan menu, no pork; not halal-certified. Prices EUR 6-12. Family-friendly. Tel +49 8362 9899750.

places.name: Alpenrose am See - Restaurant & Café
places.cuisine: Lakeside restaurant, café and self-service terrace on the Alpsee
places.near: Alpseestraße in Hohenschwangau, 2 min walk from the Neuschwanstein ticket centre; castle car parks P1-P4 (EUR 10/day)
places.order: Coffee and cake or house ice cream on the terrace after the castle; Laugenburger from the beer garden; vegan gyros
places.notes: Source: ameroncollection.com (terrace hours, menu), schwangau.de + Yelp (address/restaurant hours); Nominatim (coords)
places.famousFor: AMERON-run café-restaurant on the shore of the Alpsee directly below Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau castles; lake terrace with 'arguably the most beautiful view of Lake Alpsee', house-recipe ice cream, coffee and cake
places.goodToKnow: Restaurant Mon-Thu 12:00-17:00 & 18:00-22:00 (listings); self-service terrace 11:30-18:00 only in fine weather - in mid-October expect the terrace to be closed on wet/cold days, indoor café-restaurant should run; call +49 8362 70300 the morning of Sat 17 Oct. Coffee, cakes, ice cream, mains; vegetarian/vegan easy; not halal-certified. Mid-range (mains EUR 15-28). Family-friendly, lake path and rowing boats in season.

places.name: Reptilienhaus/Zoo Oberammergau
places.near: Oberammergau, Bavaria; in the village near the Ammergau Alps
places.order: Up-close indoor terrarium exhibits of live reptiles and amphibians
places.famousFor: Small reptile house in the Bavarian Alpine village of Oberammergau displaying snakes, lizards, tortoises and spiders
places.goodToKnow: Compact indoor attraction, good rainy-day stop while visiting Oberammergau (Passion Play, Linderhof).

places.name: Schwangau
places.near: Munich Airport (MUC), ~2h drive
places.order: Tour of Neuschwanstein Castle and the Marienbrücke viewpoint
places.famousFor: Bavarian village home to Neuschwanstein and Hohenschwangau castles below the Alps
places.goodToKnow: Best late spring-autumn; fairytale castle scenery, busy in summer

places.name: Sommerrodelbahn Tegelberg
places.near: Schwangau (Ostallgäu), near Tegelberg; take the Tegelbergbahn gondola to the start
places.order: The 760m track with twelve steep curves, a jump and a bridge, speed by your own control lever
places.famousFor: Tegelberg summer luge at the foot of the Neuschwanstein/Hohenschwangau castles
places.goodToKnow: Opened 1996; huge children's playground and beer garden at the base; age 3+ with adult, 8+ alone

places.name: Alpine Coaster
places.near: Kolbensattel, Oberammergau, Bavaria; by car or the Kolbensattel chairlift from the village.
places.order: A ride on the rail coaster where you control your own speed through the bends and dips above Oberammergau.
places.famousFor: Alpine Coaster at Oberammergau (Kolbensattel) - a year-round mountain coaster sledding down the hillside on a fixed rail with banked curves.
places.goodToKnow: User note 'زحليقه' (slide). Operates summer and winter, weather-dependent; small children ride with an adult.

places.name: Bayerische Zugspitzbahn – Zahnradbahn (Garmisch Zugspitzbahnhof)
places.near: Zugspitzbahnhof is opposite the DB station; drive 5 min from town centre; or start at Eibsee (Seilbahn, already saved) – one ticket covers both
places.famousFor: Cog railway from Garmisch through the 4.5 km tunnel to the Zugspitzplatt glacier plateau, then Gletscherbahn to the 2,962 m summit; loop back down by the Eibsee cable car
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026 (Sep–Jun daily 08:30–16:45; full closures only 9–13/16–20/23–26 Nov). Summer tariff 2026: adult €78, youth 16–18 €62.50, child 6–15 €39, FAMILY TARIFF €12.50 per child 6–18 with a parent, under 6 free; ticket = 1 ascent + 1 descent by cog train or cable car + Gletscherbahn. Family of 7 ≈ €78×2 + €12.50×5 = €218.50. Book online to skip queues. Van parking: P+R at Zugspitzbahnhof; campers/high vans → Parkplatz am Eisstadion or Hausberg (both by cog-train stops). Allow 4–5 h. · Kids: All ages; 4yo fine (seated train, ~75 min to Zugspitzplatt); take warm layers – snow likely at 2,600 m in Oct

places.name: Zugspitze summit platform, Gipfelkreuz & Zugspitzplatt Gletschergarten
places.near: Reached only by Zahnradbahn + Gletscherbahn (from Garmisch) or Seilbahn Zugspitze (from Eibsee); Austrian Tiroler Zugspitzbahn side is outside this list
places.famousFor: Germany's highest point (2,962 m): 360° panorama over 400 peaks in 4 countries, gold summit cross, Münchner Haus hut, Gletschergarten play/snow area and Panorama 2000 restaurant on the Zugspitzplatt
places.goodToKnow: Included in the Zugspitze ticket (no extra fee). Open year-round; mid-Oct usually first snow on the Platt – bring gloves/hats, sunglasses. Gletscherbahn Sep–Jun 08:30–16:45; last lifts down ~16:45 so be on top by 14:30. Weather cams on zugspitze.de – only go on a clear forecast; 2-Peak Pass (Zugspitze + Garmisch-Classic/Wank over 2 days) adult €93.50, child €47, family child €20.50. · Kids: All ages on the platforms (lifts, cafés, indoor viewing); Gipfelkreuz ladder only for teens/adults; keep the 4yo away from the edges in wind

places.name: Partnachklamm
places.near: Park at P21 Olympia-Skistadion (Karl-und-Martin-Neuner-Platz 1), then 25-min flat walk (or horse carriage in season) to the gorge entrance; bus 1/2 from the station to Skistadion
places.famousFor: 700 m limestone gorge up to 80 m deep with tunnels and galleries carved beside the roaring Partnach; open year-round, one of Bavaria's top natural monuments
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026: Oct–May 08:00–18:00, last entry 17:30. Adult €10, child 6–17 €5, under 6 free (guest-card discounts). Tickets at the kiosk/machines or online (GaPa Erlebnisshop). NOTE: path beyond the gorge toward Vordergraseck closed for works 21 Sep–20 Nov 2026 → walk in and back out the same way (~1 h incl. approach). P21 parking €5/day (vans OK, open-air). Combine with the ski-jump stadium at the car park. · Kids: Great for 9–17; the 4yo can walk it (700 m gorge path, tunnels, drips) but NO strollers/carriers with frames allowed; bring rain jackets

places.name: Höllentalklamm
places.near: From Hammersbach car park (P2) 1 h uphill walk to the gorge entrance hut, then ~45 min through the gorge; return same way (allow 4 h round trip)
places.famousFor: Wild gorge under the Zugspitze north face: tunnels, footbridges and waterfalls dropping right beside the path; ends at the Höllentalangerhütte meadow
places.goodToKnow: OPEN until 20 Oct 2026 (closes for winter that day) – so accessible Thu 15–Sat 17 Oct, weather permitting; 24 h access, kiosk at the entrance. Adult €7, child 7–17 €3.50, under 6 free (DAV members half). Parking Hammersbach P2 €5 half day / €8 day. Hut above the gorge (Höllentalangerhütte) already closed for the season – bring snacks. Sturdy shoes, headlamp handy in the tunnels. · Kids: Best for 12+; steep, wet, ~1 h up through the gorge + return. Not for the 4yo (carry impossible on wet ladders/tunnels); 9yo OK if a confident walker

places.name: Eibsee lake loop & lakeshore
places.near: A95/B2 to Grainau then Eibsee-Straße; 10 min from Garmisch; regional bus Eibsee-Bus from Garmisch station
places.notes: eibsee.de Bootsverleih; zugspitze.de Parkordnung; berginstinct Eibsee parken
places.famousFor: Emerald 'Bavarian Caribbean' lake at the foot of the Zugspitze with 8 small islands; the classic postcard view of the peak
places.goodToKnow: Lake path open year-round; boat/pedalo rental and lake ferry CLOSED after 4 Oct 2026 (season over). Parking: Parkplatz Eibsee €10/4 h then €1/h, height limit 2.10 m; Seilbahn Zugspitze car park €20/4 h (–€11 with lift ticket), vehicles >2.20 m banned after 17:30 – a 9-seat van (~1.9–2.0 m) fits, a high-roof does not. Arrive before 09:00 or after 15:00; Eibsee Hotel café/kiosk for a break. · Kids: All ages; 7.5 km flat gravel loop (2 h) works with a stroller; shorter option: 20 min to the Frillensee/islands viewpoint and back

places.name: Alpspitzbahn & AlpspiX viewing platform (Garmisch-Classic)
places.near: Valley station Am Kreuzeckbahnhof 12 (5 min from centre); P23 car park with 700 spaces at Am Kreuzeckbahnhof 1
places.notes: zugspitze.de Garmisch-Classic prices & operating times; zugspitz-region P23
places.famousFor: Two steel arms jutting 13 m over a 1,000 m drop with glass-floor ends; view of Zugspitze, Höllental and Garmisch; Genuss-Erlebnisweg family trail and playground at Hochalm
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026: Oct daily 08:30–17:00 (autumn maintenance only from 9 Nov). Garmisch-Classic ticket (up Alpspitzbahn/down Kreuzeckbahn or same): adult €39, youth 16–18 €31, child 6–15 €19.50, FAMILY TARIFF €8 per child with a parent, under 6 free → family of 7 ≈ €118. AlpspiX free with lift. Cheaper than Zugspitze and less weather-sensitive – good Plan B. Paid car park P23 (card/cash). Allow 2–3 h. · Kids: All ages; 10-min gondola to 2,050 m, AlpspiX platform is 5 min flat from the top station (fenced, stroller OK); Hochalm/Kreuzeck loop adds an easy 45-min walk

places.name: Wankbahn – Wank plateau (1,780 m)
places.near: Valley station Wankbahnstraße 2 in Partenkirchen (free/parking at the station); bus 1 stop Wankbahn
places.famousFor: Sunny 'balcony' opposite the Zugspitze/Wetterstein with the best full-panorama of Garmisch's mountains; paragliders launch here; easy summit walk to the cross
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026: summer season 3 Apr–8 Nov 2026 daily 08:45–17:00 (Oct hours 08:30–17:00 per zugspitze.de). Round trip adult €26, youth €21, child 6+ €13; family tariff on request/2-Peak Pass with Zugspitze. NOTE: first lift 08:45, sunrise ~07:45 in mid-Oct → no sunrise by lift; afternoon light is best. Wankhaus hut (DAV) usually open to early Nov – check. Duration 2–3 h. · Kids: All ages; 4-seat gondolas (20 min), gentle summit meadows, Wankhaus hut terrace; toddler-friendly plateau strolls

places.name: Olympia-Skistadion & Große Olympiaschanze (ski-jump stadium)
places.near: Same car park as Partnachklamm (P21, Karl-und-Martin-Neuner-Platz); bus 1/2 'Skistadion'
places.famousFor: 1936 Winter Olympics stadium and the Four-Hills-Tournament hill (Neujahrsspringen 1 Jan); the 2007 steel jump is a landmark of the town
places.goodToKnow: Stadium grounds open daily, FREE; walking onto the jump tower only with the guided tour (~2 h, Wed & Sat afternoons via GaPa Tourismus – confirm time/price for 17 Oct as you'll be in Schwangau; Wed 14 Oct n/a). Parking €5/day. 15-min stop before/after the Partnachklamm. · Kids: All ages; kids love standing at the outrun of the New Year's Ski-Jump hill; stroller OK

places.name: Museum Werdenfels
places.near: On the Ludwigstraße in Partenkirchen; underground garage 2 h free for visitors
places.famousFor: Regional museum in a 1600s merchant house on Ludwigstraße: Werdenfels history, carnival masks, Lüftlmalerei, Zugspitze exploration room
places.goodToKnow: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 (closed Mon; open on public holidays). Admission from €4.50 adult, children reduced. Largely barrier-free. Fri 16 Oct OK. · Kids: Rainy-day option; 12+ get the most (masks, Zugspitze room, folk art); 30–60 min

places.name: Kramerplateauweg & Pflegersee
places.near: Drive up to Wanderparkplatz Pflegersee (850 m) via Pflegersee road from Garmisch (5 min); or start at the Kramer parking below
places.famousFor: Panoramic balcony path along the foot of the Kramer above Garmisch with views of Wetterstein, Zugspitze and Karwendel; Pflegersee is a small forest lake with a Berggasthof and the Werdenfels castle ruin nearby
places.goodToKnow: Free, open year-round; ~200 m elevation from Garmisch, ~100 m from Pflegersee car park. Berggasthof Pflegersee terrace for lunch (check autumn days). Good half-day filler combining with the Friday market in town. · Kids: All ages; wide, nearly level gravel path – stroller/all-terrain buggy OK; 1.5 h loop from Pflegersee or shorter out-and-back

places.name: Kuhfluchtwasserfälle & Walderlebnispfad Farchant
places.near: 5 min north of Garmisch on the B2; park at P1 Warmfreibad Farchant (Wanderparkplatz Estergebirge) or P2 Natur- und Erholungspark Kuhflucht
places.famousFor: One of Germany's highest waterfalls (270 m over three steps) at the foot of the Estergebirge, reached by a themed forest trail with a playground and water play area at the start
places.goodToKnow: FREE, open year-round (check ice on the upper path in late Oct). Parking €0.50/2 h or €5/day; free playground with water area and small rope garden beside P1; toilets with changing table at P2. Best flow after rain. · Kids: Excellent for 4–12: forest adventure trail with play stations, 3.6 km loop (1.5–2 h); last 15 min to the falls is steeper – 4yo may need a carry

places.name: Karwendelbahn Mittenwald & Bergwelt Karwendel 'Riesenfernrohr'
places.near: Valley station Alpenkorpsstraße 1, 10-min walk from Mittenwald station; 25 min from Garmisch by car
places.notes: karwendelbahn.de schedule & prices; karwendel.org Bergwelt Karwendel
places.famousFor: Germany's second-highest cable car to the Karwendel ridge; the mountain station holds the free 'giant telescope' nature centre jutting 7 m over the cliff with a 37 m² panorama window
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026: 12–24 Oct 09:00–17:00, gondola every 30 min, last ascent 16:30 (from 25 Oct 09:30–16:30). Round trip adult €42.90, child 6–17 with a parent €9.90 (independent child €27.90), under 6 free → 2 adults + 5 kids ≈ €135.30. Bergwelt Karwendel exhibition free with the lift. Very weather-dependent – check webcam; wind closures happen. · Kids: All ages inside the cabin/exhibition; at 2,244 m expect snow and cold – short fenced viewpoints only for the 4yo; teens can walk the Panoramaweg

places.name: Geigenbaumuseum Mittenwald (violin-making museum)
places.near: Ballenhausgasse behind the parish church in the Obermarkt pedestrian zone; town car parks
places.famousFor: Museum of Mittenwald's 300-year violin-making tradition (since Matthias Klotz, 1684): historic workshop, 200 instruments, luthier demonstrations
places.goodToKnow: Low season 15 Oct–5 Nov 2026: Tue–Sun 11:00–16:00, closed Mon → Fri 16 Oct 11–16 OK. Adult €5.50, reduced/children less. Combine with Obermarkt facades and the Karwendelbahn. · Kids: Short (45 min) and quirky; 9+ enjoy the workshop and sound stations; rainy-day pick

places.name: Kloster Ettal – Basilika & abbey shop
places.near: On the B23 between Oberammergau and Garmisch (15 min); large free car park across the road
places.famousFor: Benedictine abbey (1330) with a Baroque domed basilica; the monks brew Ettaler beer and distil the famous herb liqueurs; Klosterladen for gifts
places.goodToKnow: Basilica open ~08:00–18:00, FREE. Klosterladen Mon–Sat 09:30–17:00, Sun 13:30–17:00. Brewery tour with tasting Tue & Fri 15:00 (€12), distillery tour Mon & Thu 16:00 (€9) – alcohol products; basilica tour Mon & Thu 15:00 (€5). Quick stop on the way to Linderhof/Oberammergau. · Kids: All ages; 20–30 min inside the domed basilica; strollers OK

places.name: Schaukäserei Ettal (Ammergauer Alpen show dairy)
places.near: Mandlweg 2, 3-min walk from the abbey car park
places.famousFor: Show dairy of the Ammergau hay-milk farmers: viewing gallery over the cheese vats, tasting counter, farm shop and Alm-style café next to the abbey
places.goodToKnow: Main season through 25 Oct 2026: daily 10:00–17:00 (from 26 Oct closed Mon). Viewing gallery free. Live cheese-making demo Thursdays 11:30 (May–Oct; €12 adult, children ≤14 free, pre-register) → Thu 15 Oct 2026 is a demo day; Saturday 11:00 hay-milk tasting €6.50. Café has vegetarian dishes. · Kids: Great for 4–12: watch cheese being made through the glass, dairy café with Kaiserschmarrn and cheese Spätzle; 45–60 min

places.name: Schloss Linderhof
places.near: 10 km west of Ettal on the Linderhof road (St 2060); 25 min from Garmisch; large paid car park then 10-min walk
places.famousFor: King Ludwig II's small Rococo 'Versailles' – the only palace he finished; hall of mirrors, gilded interiors, cascade and fountains, Moorish Kiosk and Venus Grotto in the park
places.goodToKnow: WINTER SEASON STARTS 16 Oct 2026: palace daily 10:00–16:30, ticket office 09:30–16:00; palace-only ticket €11 (reduced €10), under 18 FREE. VENUS GROTTO and park buildings CLOSED from 16 Oct → only Thu 15 Oct 2026 (open 09:00–18:00, combined ticket €18) lets you see the grotto; fountains also stop for winter. Timed tours – arrive early or book online (fee). Allow 1.5–2 h. · Kids: Palace tour is 25 min and strict (no strollers, no touching) – OK for 9+; toddlers can wait in the park; big gardens for running

places.name: Oberammergau village, Lüftlmalerei & Pilatushaus Lebende Werkstatt
places.near: Village centre; park at P Passionstheater / Ammergauer Haus; 20 min from Garmisch
places.famousFor: Passion-Play village famous for fresco-painted facades (Lüftlmalerei) and 250 years of woodcarving; the Pilatushaus (1784 frescoes) houses a free 'living workshop' of carvers, painters and potters
places.goodToKnow: Pilatushaus workshop FREE, open in Oct (closed 4–29 Nov); usually Mon–Sat daytime – Fri 16 Oct fine. Oberammergau Museum (Dorfstraße 8; Tue–Sun 10–17 to 8 Nov) for carvings & nativity scenes. Reptilienhaus and Alpine Coaster already on your list (Alpine Coaster/Kolbensattel runs into autumn, weather permitting). · Kids: All ages; 1-h stroll past painted fairy-tale houses (Hansel-and-Gretel house, Rotkäppchen house); live carvers in the Pilatushaus fascinate kids

places.name: Laber Bergbahn (Oberammergau)
places.near: South edge of Oberammergau (exit B23 'Oberammergau Süd', follow Laberbergbahn/Wellenberg signs); large free car park at the station
places.famousFor: Classic small gondola to the Laber summit with 360° views of the Ammergau Alps, Ettaler Manndl and Zugspitze; paraglider launch site
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026: Apr–early Nov daily 09:00–17:00 (season ends 9 Nov). Round trip adult €24.50, child €15 (single €14.50/€9); no family ticket listed. Free parking. Allow 2 h; hut lunch on top. · Kids: All ages; 4-person gondolas (10 min) to 1,684 m with the Laberei hut and easy summit meadow; less crowded than Zugspitze

places.name: Wieskirche (Pilgrimage Church of Wies, UNESCO)
places.near: On the way Oberammergau → Füssen (B23/St 2059 via Steingaden), 45 min from Garmisch; paid car park north of the church
places.famousFor: UNESCO Rococo masterpiece (1745–54) by the Zimmermann brothers standing alone in a meadow; dazzling white-gold interior and ceiling fresco
places.goodToKnow: FREE entry; open 08:00–19:00 while summer time lasts (to 25 Oct 2026), then to 17:00. 'Traffic-light' rule: sightseeing paused during services (esp. Sat/Sun mornings) – check the hours PDF on wieskirche.de. Cafés and a gift shop beside the car park; toilets. 30–45 min stop. · Kids: All ages but it is an active church – quiet 15–20 min inside; meadow outside for kids to run

places.name: Schloss Neuschwanstein
places.near: Park in Hohenschwangau (P1–P4), collect tickets at the Ticket Center Alpseestraße 12, then walk 30–40 min uphill, shuttle bus (€3 up/€2 down, stops near Marienbrücke, 15 min) or horse carriage (€7/€4, 20 min); no reservations for bus/carriage
places.notes: hohenschwangau.de ticket prices, opening times, FAQ & transport pages (Sep 2026)
places.famousFor: Ludwig II's fairy-tale castle (1869–86), model for Disney's castle; Throne Hall, Singers' Hall, Wagner-inspired murals; Marienbrücke gorge view
places.goodToKnow: YOUR SLOT: Sat 17 Oct 2026 11:40 – WINTER HOURS from 16 Oct: castle 10:00–16:00, Ticket Center 08:00–15:30. Adult €21 (reduced €20), UNDER 18 FREE, +€2.50 online fee per ticket; pick up/print tickets ≥1 h before; be at the castle gate 10 min early – late = forfeited. Parking €12/6 h (+€1/h, max €16); motorhomes/high vans use P2 (€16/6 h). Marienbrücke renovated and open, but CLOSES in snow/ice – check 'Aktuelle Mitteilungen' on hohenschwangau.de that morning; Pöllatschlucht gorge trail closed (rockfall). Allow 3 h total, then ~3.5 h drive to Zurich. · Kids: Tour is 30 min with 300+ stairs and no strollers/large bags – fine for 9+, manageable for the 4yo if carried on the stairs; kids need their own (free) ticket

places.name: Schloss Hohenschwangau
places.near: 15–20 min walk uphill from the Ticket Center/car parks (no bus; carriage €? seasonal)
places.famousFor: Ludwig II's childhood home, yellow neo-Gothic castle above the Alpsee with original royal furnishings and murals of German legends
places.goodToKnow: From 16 Oct 2026: tours daily 10:00–16:00. Adult €23.50 (reduced €19.50), child 7–17 €12, under 7 free, +€2.50 online fee. Timed tickets; combination tickets with Neuschwanstein/museum exist (Königsticket) – ask at booking. If time is tight on 17 Oct, skip this and do the museum + Alpsee instead. · Kids: 45-min guided tour, fewer stairs than Neuschwanstein; better with the 4yo; no strollers inside

places.name: Museum der Bayerischen Könige
places.near: Alpseestraße 27 on the lakeshore, 5 min from the Ticket Center; lakeside café
places.famousFor: Modern museum on the Alpsee shore telling the Wittelsbach story from Ludwig II to today; the king's famous blue-gold robe and the Alpsee panorama window
places.goodToKnow: Daily entry 09:00–16:30, closes 17:00. Adult €14.50 (reduced €13.50), children under 18 FREE with an adult, family card €19; audio guide included (EN/DE/…); +€2.50 online fee if pre-booked, walk-up fine. · Kids: Free for under-18s with audio guide; 45–60 min; good indoor filler while waiting for the castle slot; stroller OK

places.name: Tegelbergbahn (cable car, Schwangau)
places.near: Tegelbergstraße 33, 5 min from Hohenschwangau; paid car park 06:00–22:00
places.famousFor: Gondola above the royal castles with the best aerial view of Neuschwanstein, Forggensee and the Allgäu lakes; Panorama restaurant; paragliding launch
places.goodToKnow: OPEN 15–17 Oct 2026: daily 09:00–17:00 (autumn closure only 9 Nov–17 Dec). Round trip adult €32.50, child 6–15 €13, FAMILY child €8 (1–2 parents + own kids ≤17; family fares sold at the valley station only) → ≈ €105 for 7. Parking €2/2 h or €5/day, €2 refunded with lift ticket; 10 EV chargers. Summer luge runs in fair weather until the Nov closure. Weather cams first. · Kids: All ages; enclosed cabin to 1,720 m, hut and viewing terrace; summer luge at the base (already saved) is 3+ with adult

places.name: Forggensee & Füssen lakeshore
places.near: Bootshafen at Weidachstraße 80, Füssen; lakeside paths from Schwangau-Brunnen/Waltenhofen
places.famousFor: Bavaria's largest reservoir with castle and Alpine backdrop; summer boat cruises from Füssen harbour (Bootshafen)
places.goodToKnow: Boat season 1 Jun–15 Oct 2026 (28 Sep–15 Oct only 2 sailings from 12:30) → NO cruises on 16–17 Oct. The lake is a reservoir that is drawn down from mid-Oct to spring, so expect low water and mudflats – scenic drive/short stroll only, not a swim/boat day. · Kids: All ages; flat cycle/walk paths along the reservoir; no boats in your dates

places.name: Lechfall & Alatsee (Füssen)
places.near: Lechfall: small car park on Tiroler Straße (B17 south of Füssen) or Walderlebniszentrum Ziegelwies; Alatsee: 5 min west via Alatseestraße, car park at the lake
places.famousFor: Turquoise Lech river plunging through a 5-step weir and gorge at the town edge; Alatsee is a quiet emerald forest lake with a legend of glowing red water
places.goodToKnow: Both FREE, open year-round. Lechfall parking small – arrive early or park at Morisse/Ziegelwies. Alatsee car park paid (small fee). Kalvarienberg (20 min uphill from Lechfall) gives the castle + lakes view. Good 1–1.5 h combo after Neuschwanstein before the Zurich drive. · Kids: Lechfall: 10-min stop, footbridge over the falls, stroller OK. Alatsee: 1.5 km flat lake loop, stroller/wheelchair OK, bird trail – ideal for the 4yo

places.name: Murnau & Staffelsee
places.near: 25 min north of Garmisch via B2; Seehausen pier for the boat, Murnau 'Achele' pier and Seepromenade
places.famousFor: Warm, island-dotted Staffelsee in the 'Blue Land' of the Blaue Reiter painters; Murnau's painted old town and Münter-Haus; MS Seehausen ferry loop
places.goodToKnow: Ferry in Oct: only MS Seehausen and only Sat/Sun/holidays with selected (underlined) sailings → Fri 16 Oct NO boat; Sat 17 you're in Schwangau. Münter-Haus Tue–Sun 14–17 (Kottmüllerallee 6, Murnau). Free lake walks year-round; Seehausen lido closed for season. Optional stop if driving in from Munich. · Kids: All ages; lakeside promenade and Seehausen beach meadow; ferry only weekends in Oct; Münter-Haus (Kandinsky/Münter art) suits 12+

places.name: Freilichtmuseum Glentleiten (open-air museum)
places.near: A95 exit Ohlstadt / B2 via Murnau, 30 min from Garmisch; free car park; museum shuttle from the car park
places.famousFor: Upper Bavaria's largest open-air museum on a hillside above Kochelsee: relocated Alpine farms, mills, sawmill, chapels, working smithy and beer garden
places.goodToKnow: Oct 2026: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 (closed Mon) → Fri 16 Oct OK; season ends 8 Nov. Adult €11, children/young people to 18 €2 (family of 7 = €32). Online tickets available. Allow 3 h; wear walking shoes (hilly site). · Kids: Top pick for 4–12: 60+ historic farmhouses, animals (goats, cattle, chickens), craft demos, playground; whole-day outdoor site with pushchair-friendly main paths

places.name: Isar-Natur-Erlebnisweg Krün & Isarstausee
places.near: Krün village car park / Isarstausee parking on the Wallgau road; 20 min from Garmisch via B2 (Klais)
places.famousFor: Family nature trail along the wild, turquoise Upper Isar between Krün and Wallgau with interactive stations; loop around the Isar reservoir (Isarstausee) with Karwendel views
places.goodToKnow: FREE, open year-round (water stations may be drained in autumn). 2–2.5 h round; combine with Geroldsee/Barmsee photo stops (5 min away). Tourist offices in Krün/Wallgau have the trail map. · Kids: Built for kids: 6 km themed loop with water play, raft, tree-telephone stations; ~100 m elevation; buggy OK on most of it

places.name: Königliche Kristall-Therme Schwangau
places.near: Am Ehberg 16 by the Kurpark in Schwangau, 5 min from Hohenschwangau; free parking on site
places.famousFor: Thermal spa with six brine pools (32–36 °C, up to 24 % salt) and a panorama pool looking at Neuschwanstein; sauna village with lake
places.goodToKnow: Open year-round: Mon–Thu 09:00–21:00, Fri–Sat 09:00–22:00 (Sun to 21:00). Pools-only tariff: 2 h adult €19 / youth 6–15 €10.50 / under 6 €3; 4 h €28/€16; day €35.50/€19. Bring swimwear (mandatory in pools). Ideal Thu 15 Oct evening after arriving, or Fri afternoon. · Kids: Warm salt pools with castle view suit all ages (children's area, but no big slides); sauna zone is nude/adults – stay in the pool zone; under-6 pay €3

places.name: Alpspitz-Wellenbad Garmisch (CLOSED during your visit)
places.near: Klammstraße 47, near the Olympic stadium
places.famousFor: The town's wave pool and slide complex, under a €30 m+ full renovation since 2023
places.goodToKnow: CLOSED: public reopening scheduled 30 Nov 2026 (schools from 19 Oct). No indoor pool alternative in Garmisch itself for your dates → use Kristall-Therme Schwangau or the Wellenberg pool in Oberammergau (WellenBerg, Himmelreich 52 – check hours). · Kids: Would suit all ages – but NOT available 15–17 Oct 2026

places.name: Garmisch pedestrian zone – Am Kurpark / Marienplatz / Mohrenplatz
places.near: Town centre; underground garages Am Kurpark/Kongresshaus (height limit ~2.0 m – 9-seat van better in open-air P at Bahnhof or Am Eisstadion)
places.order: Trachten (dirndl/lederhosen), felt hats, Bavarian beer steins, Dallmayr/Lindt gifts, Sport Conrad outdoor gear
places.famousFor: The town's main shopping streets: Trachten houses, Bavarian hats, outdoor brands, cuckoo clocks, chocolate & Lebkuchen, plus cafés around Marienplatz
places.goodToKnow: Shops Mon–Sat ~09:30–18:30, closed SUNDAY (Germany). No factory outlet anywhere nearby – nearest are Ingolstadt Village (2 h) / Outletcity Metzingen (3 h); skip. Friday morning weekly market in this same zone (see market row). · Kids: Easy 1-h stroll; ice cream, toy shop, Kurpark playground next door

places.name: Wochenmarkt Garmisch (Friday morning market)
places.near: Walk from any town-centre car park
places.order: Bergkäse and Werdenfels cheeses, mountain honey, Brezn and Zwetschgendatschi, dried-fruit and nuts for the drive
places.famousFor: Weekly farmers' market through the pedestrian zone from Marienplatz to Bischofseck/Mohrenplatz: Alpine cheeses, honey, sausages, bread, regional fruit and flowers
places.goodToKnow: EVERY FRIDAY morning until ~12:00–12:30 → Fri 16 Oct 2026. Partenkirchen has its own market Thursdays 08:00–13:00 on Ludwigstraße (Thu 15 Oct). NO Saturday market in Garmisch-Partenkirchen. Cash helpful. · Kids: Fun 30 min for kids: pretzels, cheese tasting, fruit; stroller OK

places.name: Ludwigstraße, Partenkirchen (historic street)
places.near: Underground garage at Museum Werdenfels (2 h free) or P Rathausplatz
places.order: Schönegger Käse-Alm (Ludwigstraße 22) hay-milk mountain cheese, Bavarian deli goods at Feinkost shops, local honey, woodcarvings
places.famousFor: Cobbled old Roman-road high street lined with Lüftlmalerei facades, small delis, gift shops, the Werdenfels museum and Gasthof Fraundorfer
places.goodToKnow: Shops Mon–Fri ~09:00–18:00, Sat mornings, closed Sun. Schönegger Käse-Alm: Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 & 14:00–18:00 (Sat: check). Thursday market 08:00–13:00 here (15 Oct). · Kids: 20-min stroll; painted houses make it a photo walk too

places.name: Trachten- & Modehaus Grasegger
places.near: In the pedestrian zone next to the Spielbank; underground garage beneath the building
places.order: Kids' lederhosen & dirndl sets, loden coat, Trachten hat, embroidered belts
places.famousFor: Garmisch's classic Trachten house since 1920 with its own workshop: dirndls, lederhosen, loden jackets, felt hats, Haferl shoes for men, women and kids
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Fri 09:30–18:30, Sat 09:30–17:00, closed Sun. Tax-free shopping forms for non-EU visitors available (ask). Fri 16 Oct fine. · Kids: Children's dirndls/lederhosen from toddler sizes – fun family outfits; 30–60 min

places.name: Sport Conrad Garmisch-Partenkirchen
places.near: Chamonixstraße 3 near the station; store car park
places.order: Warm layers/gloves for the Zugspitze, kids' waterproofs, Bavarian-brand outdoor gear
places.famousFor: 2,000 m² flagship of the Bavarian outdoor chain: mountaineering, ski, trail and kids' outdoor wear (Mammut, Patagonia, Salewa, Ortovox)
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Fri 09:30–19:00, Sat 09:30–18:00, closed Sun. Tax-free (non-EU) available. · Kids: Kids' hiking boots, rain gear and beanies if the weather turns; 30 min

places.name: Ettaler Klosterladen (abbey shop)
places.near: Across the road from the abbey car park (free)
places.order: Ettaler honey & jams, hay-milk cheese, monastery chocolate, herbal teas, natural cosmetics (note: liqueurs/beer contain alcohol)
places.famousFor: Monastery shop selling Ettaler products: herb liqueurs (alcoholic), monastery beer, cheeses, honey, jams, soaps, books and religious art; gift baskets
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 09:30–17:00, Sun & holidays 13:30–17:00. Combine with the basilica and the Schaukäserei shop next door (Mandlweg 2, daily 10–17). · Kids: Kids like the abbey honey, chocolate and the monastery gift corner; 20 min

places.name: Mittenwald Obermarkt (old town pedestrian zone)
places.near: Town car parks at the edge of the pedestrian zone; 25 min from Garmisch
places.order: Miniature violin souvenirs, carved Krampus/wooden toys, Trachten hats, 'Kunterbuntes aus Mittenwald' gifts, Mittenwald Bergkäse
places.famousFor: Goethe's 'living picture book': fresco-painted facades, the Baroque church tower, master violin-makers' workshops (Sandner at Obermarkt 29, Maller at Obermarkt 2) and souvenir/Trachten shops
places.goodToKnow: Shops Mon–Fri ~09:00–18:00 (many close 12–14), Sat to ~13:00–16:00, Sun closed. Violin workshops are working ateliers – ask before entering. Combine with Geigenbaumuseum and Karwendelbahn. · Kids: Short flat stroll; violin workshops let kids peek through windows; ice cream stops

places.name: Georg Lang sel. Erben – Oberammergau woodcarvings
places.near: Dorfstraße 20 in the village centre, 3 min walk from the Passionstheater car park
places.order: Hand-carved nativity animals or a small Oberammergau figure, carved cross, Christmas ornaments
places.famousFor: Oldest Oberammergau carving house (since 1775, 8 generations): several hundred own models – nativity figures, animals, crosses, Madonnas in 16–40 cm sizes
places.goodToKnow: Shop Mon–Tue & Thu–Fri 10:00–12:00 and 14:00–17:00, Wed 10:00–12:00, CLOSED Sat & Sun → only Thu 15 / Fri 16 Oct 2026. Genuine hand-carved pieces are pricey (from ~€50 up to thousands); ships worldwide. · Kids: Museum-like showroom; kids see nativity animals and carved figures; 30 min

places.name: Oberammergau Dorfstraße carving & souvenir shops
places.near: P at Ammergauer Haus/Passionstheater; 20 min from Garmisch
places.order: Small carved animals, Christmas tree ornaments, Passion-Play souvenirs, Bavarian cuckoo clock, painted wooden toys
places.famousFor: The village's main street: woodcarving showrooms (Toni Baur, Albl studio, Heinzeller 'Der Laden'), nativity workshops (Ammergauer Krippenstube), cuckoo clocks, Christmas decorations year-round
places.goodToKnow: Most shops Mon–Sat ~09:30–18:00, some open Sun in season; Oct is quieter than Passion-Play years. Price range huge – machine-carved vs hand-carved, ask which. Combine with Pilatushaus (free live workshop) and the Oberammergau Museum (Dorfstraße 8, Tue–Sun 10–17). · Kids: Easy stroll; many shops let kids watch carvers at the bench

places.name: Füssen Altstadt – Reichenstraße
places.near: Park at P Morisse or Sparkassen garage; 10 min from Neuschwanstein
places.order: Allgäu Bergkäse, Trachten accessories, castle souvenirs, Lebkuchen, kids' rain ponchos at Woolworth (Reichenstraße 11)
places.famousFor: Füssen's painted-facade high street below the Hohes Schloss: Trachten, souvenirs, Allgäu cheese shops, cafés with Mediterranean flair, Woolworth for cheap essentials
places.goodToKnow: Shops Mon–Sat ~09:00–18:30 (Woolworth to 19:00), closed Sun. Sat 17 Oct afternoon works if you leave Neuschwanstein by 14:00. Lechfall is 3 min away by car. · Kids: Flat pedestrian street, gelato and pretzel stops; 45 min before the Zurich drive

places.name: Kunterbuntes aus Mittenwald (souvenir shop)
places.near: Obermarkt pedestrian zone
places.order: Bavarian hats/beanies, collectible pins, plush marmots, postcards
places.famousFor: Well-stocked souvenir and gift shop in the Obermarkt with hats, plush, collectibles and 'raritäten' from the Karwendel region
places.goodToKnow: Typical hours Mon–Sat daytime, Sun closed; small shop – cash/card. · Kids: Kids' plush, hats, collectibles; 15 min

places.name: Eibsee north shore viewpoint (Zugspitze reflection)
places.near: Parkplatz Eibsee (€10/4 h, 2.10 m height limit)
places.order: Best 08:00–10:00 before wind ripples the surface and crowds arrive; walk 10 min anticlockwise from the hotel to the island bays (Frillensee side); autumn larches add gold
places.famousFor: The classic Eibsee shot: emerald water, the small wooded islands and the Zugspitze north face mirrored on calm mornings
places.goodToKnow: Year-round. Mid-Oct often gives morning mist then clear skies; check the Zugspitze webcam first. No drone flying (nature reserve). · Kids: Flat 10–20 min walk from the car park; safe shoreline for the 4yo

places.name: Zugspitze Gipfelkreuz & summit panorama terrace
places.near: Via Zahnradbahn+Gletscherbahn or Seilbahn Zugspitze
places.order: Late morning to early afternoon (11:00–14:00) for the clearest air; shoot the cross from the Münchner Haus terrace or with the Austrian side in the background; sunglasses and gloves
places.famousFor: Golden summit cross at 2,962 m with the Alps rolling to Austria, Italy and Switzerland; the glass Seilbahn cabins arriving below
places.goodToKnow: Included in the lift ticket. Clear-day only; last lift down ~16:45. Photos on the cross ladder are queued – be patient. · Kids: Terrace safe for all; the cross itself needs a short exposed climb – teens with an adult only

places.name: AlpspiX platform (Alpspitze)
places.near: Alpspitzbahn top station, 5 min walk
places.order: Afternoon light (14:00–16:30) lights the Zugspitze face; wide lens from the tip looking back along the arm, or from the second arm across to the other; go on a clear, still day
places.famousFor: X-shaped steel arms hovering 1,000 m above the Höllental with the Zugspitze, Alpspitze north face and Garmisch valley in one frame
places.goodToKnow: Free with the Garmisch-Classic ticket; open with the Alpspitzbahn (Oct 08:30–17:00). Can be windy/cold – hats. · Kids: Fenced steel walkway, stroller OK to the platform; glass floor thrills the 9–17s

places.name: Marienbrücke (Queen Mary's Bridge) – Neuschwanstein view
places.near: Shuttle bus €3 up (stops 5 min below the bridge) or 15-min walk up from the castle
places.order: Early morning (before 10:00) or last hour before dusk to avoid crowds; afternoon sun lights the castle's south-east facade; in Oct the larches and beech turn gold – also try the path beyond the bridge for a wider frame (careful, unfenced)
places.famousFor: THE fairy-tale postcard: Neuschwanstein from the bridge over the Pöllat gorge, with Alpsee and Forggensee behind
places.goodToKnow: Renovated and OPEN, but CLOSED whenever there is snow/ice or high wind – hohenschwangau.de 'Aktuelle Mitteilungen' announces daily. Pöllatschlucht gorge trail below is closed (rockfall). With an 11:40 tour, go to the bridge FIRST (bus from 09:00-ish) then walk down 15 min to the castle. · Kids: Bridge is narrow and often packed – hold the 4yo's hand; 5–10 min from the shuttle-bus stop, 15 min uphill from the castle

places.name: Neuschwanstein from Alpsee shore & Aussichtspunkt Jugend
places.near: Alpseestraße lakeshore behind the Museum der Bayerischen Könige; trail signed 'Jugend' from Hohenschwangau
places.order: Morning (08:00–10:00) for still water reflections on the Alpsee; Jugend viewpoint best mid-afternoon with sun on the castle; from Hohenschwangau car park walk up the Pindarplatz path
places.famousFor: Both castles seen together across the dark-green Alpsee; from 'Jugend' viewpoint above the lake, Neuschwanstein sits framed by the Tegelberg cliffs
places.goodToKnow: Free, year-round. Alpsee loop 5 km/1.5 h if you want more. Quick, uncrowded alternative to Marienbrücke if the bridge is closed for ice. · Kids: Alpsee shore is a flat stroll from the museum (stroller OK); the Jugend viewpoint is a 40-min uphill forest walk – 9+ only

places.name: Wieskirche interior & meadow approach
places.near: Car park north of the church (paid)
places.order: Inside: midday (11:00–14:00) when high windows light the nave; no flash/tripods, respect the traffic-light service times. Outside: golden hour from the east meadow path with the Alps as backdrop
places.famousFor: Ceiling fresco and white-gold Rococo stucco flooded with light; from outside, the lone church in the meadow with the Ammergau Alps behind
places.goodToKnow: Free. Photography allowed outside of services. Souvenir stalls and café at the car park. · Kids: Quiet inside; kids run on the meadow outside

places.name: Partnachklamm gorge galleries
places.near: From P21 Skistadion, 25-min walk
places.order: Midday when some light drops into the gorge; slow shutter for silky water (brace on the railing, tripods impractical); lens cloth essential – constant spray
places.famousFor: Blue-green torrent squeezed between 80 m rock walls, dripping tunnels and the lit gallery sections; in late autumn icicles begin
places.goodToKnow: Entry €10/€5; Oct 08:00–18:00. Return the same way (upper path closed to 20 Nov 2026). · Kids: Wet, dim, narrow – kids in rain jackets; no strollers

places.name: Mittenwald Obermarkt facades & St. Peter und Paul tower
places.near: Town centre car parks
places.order: Morning 09:00–11:00 with sun on the west-facing facades; stand at the south end of Obermarkt looking north to stack the tower and the Karwendel; late afternoon for the church front
places.famousFor: Frescoed Lüftlmalerei houses (Neunerhaus, Goethe-Haus), the painted church tower and the Karwendel wall rising directly behind the street
places.goodToKnow: Free. Combine with the Geigenbaumuseum and Karwendelbahn. · Kids: Flat, café-lined – easy with all kids

places.name: Geroldsee (Wagenbrüchsee) & Barmsee – Karwendel reflection
places.near: Barmsee car park (Krün, off the B2 Klais road), paid ~€6–8/day; 20 min from Garmisch
places.order: SUNRISE (~07:40 mid-Oct) from the gently rising north-shore meadow – fog lifts around 08:00–09:00; Barmsee (5 min) for a wider Karwendel panorama; 3-lakes loop Barmsee–Geroldsee–Grubsee 1 h
places.famousFor: Bavaria's most-photographed small lake: hay barns on the north shore, Karwendel and Wetterstein mirrored in the water, morning fog and larches in October
places.goodToKnow: Free access year-round; car park fees ~€6–8/day (2026). Very popular – early = empty. Respect the meadow fences (private hay fields). · Kids: 10-min flat walk from the car park to the north-shore meadow; kids can wander; no swimming in Oct

places.name: Schmalensee (Mittenwald) mirror lake
places.near: Small car park on the Mittenwald–Klais road (signed Schmalensee), 5 min from Mittenwald
places.order: Dawn to 09:00 for a glass-flat reflection; from the small car park walk to the north-east shore and shoot south toward the Karwendel; also lovely at dusk
places.famousFor: 7-hectare shallow lake beside the B2 between Klais and Mittenwald that mirrors the Karwendel wall on windless mornings; Buckelwiesen hummock meadows around it
places.goodToKnow: Free. Pair with Geroldsee/Barmsee (10 min apart) for a sunrise photo circuit before the Karwendelbahn opens at 09:00. · Kids: Roadside lake, 5-min stop; safe grassy shore

places.name: DITIB Mimar Sinan Camii (Garmisch mosque)
places.near: Burgstraße 41 in the Sonnenbichl quarter, ~1.5 km north of the Garmisch centre on the road towards Farchant; street parking
places.notes: joinhalal.com + moscheesuche.de + mapcarta (Burgstraße); qibla computed great-circle; coords OSM Nominatim (house-level, tagged DITIB Mimar Sinan Camii)
places.famousFor: The only mosque in the Garmisch-Partenkirchen area: DITIB Türkisch-Islamischer Kulturverein with minaret, wudu facilities, women's section, resident imam, Friday prayer (khutbah in Turkish). NOTE: address is Burgstraße 41 – NOT Ludwigstraße 88
places.goodToKnow: Tel +49 8821 71676; prayer times via Diyanet app. Qibla from Garmisch ≈ 128° (SE). Fri 16 Oct Jumu'ah ~13:00 – phone to confirm; small community mosque, doors may be locked outside prayer times

places.name: Prayer rooms near Neuschwanstein/Murnau: DITIB Füssen + DITIB Murnau
places.near: Füssen-West industrial estate, 12 min from Hohenschwangau P4; Murnau one is by the Viehmarktplatz car park in the town centre
places.notes: Waze listing (DITIB Moschee Füssen) + ditib.de directory (Murnau Viehmarktplatz 3); coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: Two more small DITIB community mosques on your routes: DITIB Moschee Füssen (Zalingerstraße 6, 5 min from Neuschwanstein car parks) and DITIB Türkisch-Islamische Gemeinde Murnau (Viehmarktplatz 3)
places.goodToKnow: Neither publishes hours – community mosques, usually open at prayer times only. Qibla ≈ 128°. Otherwise pray at the holiday house / in the van (bring travel mats)

places.name: E center EDEKA Amselstraße (largest supermarket)
places.near: Amselstraße 2 off the B2/Von-Brug-Straße at the north edge of Garmisch, 4 min from the mosque; big free customer car park
places.notes: edeka.de market page + supermarktcheck.de (counters, hours pattern); coords OSM Nominatim (house-level, tagged EDEKA)
places.famousFor: The biggest supermarket in town: cheese, fish and meat counters, bakery, drinks department, large produce and international shelves – best bet for lentils, rice, spices, Turkish/Arabic basics. Halal-labelled meat NOT guaranteed – see Sham Market for halal
places.goodToKnow: ALL SHOPS CLOSED SUNDAY in Bavaria (18 Oct) – do the big shop Thu evening (open till ~20:00) or Fri. Most GaPa supermarkets run Mon–Sat 07:00–20:00; confirm exact E center hours on edeka.de (page blocked automated fetch)

places.name: REWE Hauptstraße 82 (with Ihle bakery)
places.near: Hauptstraße 82 on the main road through Partenkirchen; customer car park
places.notes: rewe.de + kaufda.de (Ihle Sunday) + supermarktcheck.de; coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: Full-range REWE in Partenkirchen with pick-up station; the Ihle bakery at the entrance is open Sunday morning for bread/pastries when everything else is shut
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat ~07:00–20:00, Sunday CLOSED (bakery only, Sun 07:00–17:00 or 08:00–11:00 depending on listing – go early). Also Lidl Hauptstraße 24 nearby

places.name: Aldi Süd + Lidl + Norma discounters
places.near: Von-Brug-Straße 7 strip is 3 min from the centre on the B2; Lidl Olympiastraße 25a is opposite the Zugspitzbahn valley station
places.famousFor: Cheap staples: Aldi Süd Von-Brug-Straße 7 (with dm drugstore and EDEKA next door – one-stop strip), Lidl Olympiastraße 25a (near the Zugspitzbahn station), Lidl Hauptstraße 24, Norma Zugspitzstraße
places.goodToKnow: Aldi Mon–Sat 08:00–19:00/20:00 (listings differ); Lidl Mon–Sat 07:00–20:00; ALL CLOSED SUNDAY. Lidl Olympiastraße: 47.4916282, 11.0957665

places.name: Sham Market – Arabische & Türkische Lebensmittel
places.near: Von-Brug-Straße 22, 300 m east of the Aldi/EDEKA strip; on-street parking
places.notes: meinprospekt.de Hermes Paketshop listing + deutschbranchenbuch.com; coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: The one Arabic/Turkish grocery in Garmisch-Partenkirchen (also a Hermes parcel shop): Middle-Eastern staples, bread, sweets; ask whether they stock halal meat/chicken ('helal et var mı?' / 'لحم حلال؟') – a dedicated halal butcher could NOT be verified in town
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:30–19:00, Sun closed (Hermes-shop listing). One directory gives Breitenauer Straße as an older address – Von-Brug-Straße 22 is the current one. No 'Öz…'/'Istanbul Market' exists in GaPa

places.name: Alte Apotheke am Marienplatz + Bahnhof-Apotheke + emergency rota
places.near: Marienplatz 10 in the pedestrian zone; Bahnhofstraße 36 between station and centre
places.notes: dasoertliche.de + gesund.de (Alte Apotheke hours) + bahnhofapotheke-garmisch.de (Notdienst link) + aponet.de; coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: Central pharmacies: Alte Apotheke (Marienplatz 10) and Bahnhof-Apotheke (Bahnhofstraße 36, tel +49 8821 2450). Night/Sunday duty pharmacy rotates – check the Bavarian rota portal or the notice on any pharmacy door
places.goodToKnow: Alte Apotheke Mon–Fri 08:30–18:00, Sat 08:30–12:30, Sun closed. Notdienst (24 h duty pharmacy) lookup: aponet.de/notdienstsuche/82467 or lak-bayern.notdienst-portal.de; €2.50 night-service fee. Bahnhof-Apotheke: 47.4933742, 11.0968445

places.name: Klinikum Garmisch-Partenkirchen – ER, Kinderklinik, KVB on-call practice
places.near: Auenstraße 6, east edge of Partenkirchen towards Kainzenbad, 6 min from the centre; visitor car park; entrance via Notaufnahme
places.notes: klinikum-gap.de (ER + KV Bereitschaftspraxis pages) + doctolib.de + dastelefonbuch (116117 hours); coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: District hospital with 24 h Zentrale Notaufnahme (ER), a paediatric department (Kinder- & Jugendmedizin, emergencies round the clock) and the KVB Bereitschaftspraxis (GP out-of-hours practice) inside the ER for non-emergencies
places.goodToKnow: EMERGENCY 112 (ambulance/fire), police 110. ER tel +49 8821 77-1210; paediatric emergency +49 8821 77-1200. Out-of-hours GP: call 116117 (free) or walk in to the Bereitschaftspraxis: Thu 19–23, Fri 14–23, Sat–Sun 08–23. Bring passports + insurance/credit card (EU tourists pay upfront)

places.name: P3 Kongresshaus car park (open-air – safe for the 2.0 m van)
places.near: Parkstraße 4, signposted 'P3 Kongresshaus' from the B2/Bahnhofstraße; EV chargers at the Kongresshaus
places.notes: zugspitz-region.de POI (address, coords) + parkinglist.de (capacity, tariff) + markt.gapa.de tariff table + parkinglist (GEP/Badgasse 2.10 m)
places.famousFor: 126-space surface lot next to the Kurpark, tourist info and the Garmisch pedestrian zone – NO height barrier, so the best central choice for a high van. AVOID the underground garages: Tiefgarage GEP P2 and Badgasse P13 are 2.10 m (tight but passable at 2.0 m); other garages unlisted
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 08:00–20:00: €0.50 per 30 min, max 4 h; FREE outside those hours and all Sunday. Also Marienplatz (2 h max) and Rathausplatz Partenkirchen (4 h max) at €0.50/30 min; Wittelsbacher Park 12 h €5. Parkplatz Hauptbahnhof (87 spaces, Bahnhofstraße)

places.name: P21 Olympia-Skistadion car park (Partnachklamm)
places.near: Karl-und-Martin-Neuner-Platz 1, follow 'Skistadion/Partnachklamm' signs from Partenkirchen; buses 321/322 stop here
places.famousFor: Large paid surface lot at the 1936 Olympic ski jump – the official car park for the Partnachklamm gorge (25-min flat walk or horse carriage to the gorge entrance); no height barrier
places.goodToKnow: €5 per 24 h (€10/48 h, €15/72 h), pay machine card/cash. Partnachklamm Oct: 08:00–18:00, adults €10, kids 6–17 €5, under 6 free (family of 7 ≈ €35–40)

places.name: Eibsee car parks (lake lot + Zugspitze cable-car lot)
places.near: End of the Eibsee toll-free road from Grainau (15 min from Garmisch); arrive before 09:30 for the early-bird rate and a space
places.notes: zugspitz-region.de POI pages (both lots: address, coords, height limits) + fewo-garmisch.bayern 2026 tariff + eibsee.de
places.famousFor: Two paid lots at the Eibsee: Eibsee-Parkplatz (Am Eibsee 1, 530 spaces, at the lake – HEIGHT LIMIT 2.10 m, OK for a 2.0 m van, no campers) and the Seilbahn Zugspitze lot (Am Eibsee 6, 630 spaces, 4 EV chargers, 2.20 m bar 17:00–08:00)
places.goodToKnow: Lake lot: early bird 05:00–09:30 €2.50; up to 4 h €10, then €1/h; open 05:00–22:00, night ban. Cable-car lot: €20/4 h then €2/h, €11 refunded with a cable-car/cogwheel ticket; overnight €25. Card/cash

places.name: Neuschwanstein: Hohenschwangau car parks P1–P4 + Ticket Center
places.near: A7/B17 to Schwangau then 'Hohenschwangau/Königsschlösser' signs; from Garmisch ~1 h 25 via Oberammergau–Steingaden (B23/B17), 60 min drive to Zurich follows on the A7/A96
places.notes: hohenschwangau.de (parking, transport, opening-times pages); no house-level coordinates for P4 found – left blank (Alpseestraße 24 area ≈ 47.5544, 10.7367 per OSM)
places.famousFor: Cars park at P1–P4 on Alpseestraße (no driving up to the castle). P4 Alpsee lot is the shuttle-bus stop; P1 & P4 take buses, so a 2.0 m van is fine. Ticket Center Hohenschwangau (Alpseestraße 12) is where online tickets are checked/collected – arrive well before your 11:40 slot
places.goodToKnow: Parking 2026: cars €12 for 6 h, +€1/h, €16 max (card/cash). Shuttle bus P4→Marienbrücke €3.50 up / €5 return, kids 7–12 €2/€3, under 6 free; last uphill 17:30; walk 30–40 min uphill. Horse carriage €8 up/€4 down from Hotel Müller. Ticket Center from 16 Oct: daily 08:00–15:30 (until 15 Oct 08:00–16:00), tel +49 8362 93083-0

places.name: Bayerische Zugspitzbahn valley station – tickets & cogwheel train
places.near: Olympiastraße 27 next to the DB station (Bahnhofstraße 31), Lidl opposite; use Parkplatz Hauptbahnhof or P3
places.notes: zugspitze.de summer-2026 tariff PDF (Sommer-Zahnradbahn Komplettübersicht) + opening-hours page + bahndampf.de; no house-level coordinates found
places.famousFor: Ticket office and departure point of the cogwheel train to the Zugspitze (75 min) or drive to the Eibsee and take the cable car (10 min, 08:30–16:45 Sep–Jun). Tickets also sold at the Tourist Information and online at zugspitze.de
places.goodToKnow: SUMMER 2026 Ticket Zugspitze (return): adult €78, youth 16–18 €62.50, child 6–15 €39, CHILD IN FAMILY €12.50 each with a paying parent (under 6 free) → family of 7 ≈ €78×2 + 4×€12.50 = €206. Last cogwheel ascent 14:15 from Garmisch. Check zugspitze.de for autumn revision closures

places.name: Tourist Information Garmisch-Partenkirchen (GaPa Tourismus)
places.near: Richard-Strauss-Platz 2, on the edge of the Michael-Ende-Kurpark, 1 min from P3 Kongresshaus
places.notes: gapa-tourismus.de Tourist Information page (hours) + zugspitz-region.de POI (address/coords)
places.famousFor: Main tourist office next to the Kongresshaus and P3: mountain-railway tickets, maps, the GaPa guest card (discounts at Wellenbad/Partnachklamm), room and event info in German/English; e-bike charging outside
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00, Sat 09:00–15:00, Sun/holidays 09:00–13:00. Tel +49 8821 180700, info@gapa-tourismus.de. Ask your holiday-house host for the GaPa-Card/guest card – it is issued with the Kurtaxe

places.name: Fuel 24 h + EV charging + car wash (Zugspitzstraße strip)
places.near: Zugspitzstraße (B23 towards Grainau/Eibsee), 4 min west of the centre – fill up here before the Zurich drive
places.notes: hoyer.de + clever-tanken.de (TopTank 24 h) + billig-tanken.de (Esso hours) + goingelectric.de/evlade.de (EV) + sb-waschanlagen.com; no house-level coordinates found
places.famousFor: TopTank (Hoyer) Zugspitzstraße 42: open 24 h daily with shop and car wash – the Sunday/late-night shop in town. Esso Zugspitzstraße 44 next door (Sun 08:00–19:00) with the Alpspitz-Waschstraße. EV: 4×22 kW AC at Rathausplatz (24/7), Marienplatz 17, Kongresshaus, and 4 chargers at the Eibsee cable-car lot – no DC fast charger in the centre found
places.goodToKnow: TopTank 24/7, tel +49 8821 51662; Esso Mon–Sat 06:00–20:00, Sun 08:00–19:00. SB wash boxes: Drosselstraße 1 and 5. Van height: use the SB boxes rather than a tunnel wash

places.name: Garmisch-Partenkirchen Bahnhof – DB Reisezentrum, Post counter, taxi rank
places.near: Bahnhofstraße 31; Parkplatz Hauptbahnhof (87 spaces) in front; buses 1/2 and 321/322 from the forecourt
places.notes: bahnhof.de (Reisezentrum, parking) + kaufda.de/nochoffen.de (Post kiosk) + taxi-garmisch.de + taxi-gaparide.de; coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: Main station (trains to Munich hourly ~1 h 20, Mittenwald/Innsbruck, Zugspitzbahn next door). DB Reisezentrum ticket desk, Deutsche Post counter in the station bookshop/kiosk (open daily to 20:00), taxi rank outside. Taxis: Taxivereinigung Garmisch 24/7, Gaparide/Cumali Großraumtaxi (8-seater) +49 176 45600900
places.goodToKnow: DB Reisezentrum Mon–Fri 08:30–17:30, Sat 08:30–13:30, Sun closed (machines 24 h). Post kiosk Mon–Fri 06:00–20:00, Sat–Sun 07:00–20:00. Taxi Cumali also +49 8821 7087874

places.name: Laundromat: Wash Point Gap + SB Waschsalon

places.notes: gelbeseiten.de + waschsalons.com.de + cylex listings; no house-level coordinates found
places.famousFor: Self-service laundries for a family of 7 mid-trip: Wash Point Gap (Bahnhofstraße 13, tel +49 1522 6573152) and SB Waschsalon (Zugspitzstraße 17, tel +49 8821 9669012); Heymes Wäscherei (Münchner Straße 12) does service washes
places.goodToKnow: SB Waschsalon listed Mon–Wed 09:30–18:00 (rest of week unclear); Wash Point Gap hours not published – call first. Coin/card machines; bring detergent pods

places.name: Alpspitz-Wellenbad (wave pool) – rainy-day option
places.near: Klammstraße 47, south edge of Garmisch below the Kramer, 5 min drive; free car park
places.notes: schwimmbadcheck.de + kimapa.de + Yelp (hours/prices/address); coords OSM Nominatim (house-level, tagged Alpspitz-Wellenbad)
places.famousFor: Indoor/outdoor leisure pool with 2,200 m² water: wave pool, warm-water pool, baby and non-swimmer pools, diving pool, slide – the standard bad-weather plan for all five kids
places.goodToKnow: Mon–Sat 09:00–21:00, Sun 09:00–19:00. Adults ~€9.80; family card €14/3 h or €20 day ticket (listing – verify at the desk; guest-card discount). Tel +49 8821 753-6313. Mixed pool – separate sessions not offered

places.name: Indoor play for the 4-year-old: slöks Salz.Spiel.Raum + DAV Boulderhalle
places.near: St.-Martin-Straße 6 in Partenkirchen, 3 min from Rathausplatz car park
places.notes: freizeitmonster.de indoor-play list (slöks address, Hoppolino) + freizeitinsider.de (DAV Boulderhalle); coords OSM Nominatim (house-level)
places.famousFor: Only indoor play space in town: slöks salt-room play area for children up to 8 (natural materials, reduced-stimulus, parents sit in). For the older kids: DAV Boulderhalle Garmisch (160 m² indoor bouldering). Nearest true Indoorspielplatz is HOPPOLINO Kinderland Weilheim (Münchener Str. 67A, ~40 min)
places.goodToKnow: slöks hours/booking not published – check freizeitmonster listing/Instagram and book a session; Wellenbad is the reliable fallback

places.name: Road rules: Austrian vignette on the Thu arrival, no Umweltzone in GaPa
places.near: Border crossing Scharnitz (A) – Mittenwald (D) on the B2, 25 min south of Garmisch; Zirler Berg descent is 16 % – use low gear in the van
places.notes: karwendel-urlaub.de + seefeld.com + holidaycheck forum (B177 vignette-free, Zirl warning) + stmuv/lfu.bayern.de (Umweltzonen list); no coordinates (route note)
places.famousFor: Thu 15 Oct from Italy: Brenner A13 (Austria) needs the Austrian digital vignette (1-day €9.30-ish) PLUS the Brenner toll; A12 Inntal through Innsbruck also needs the vignette. The Seefeld road B177 Zirl→Seefeld→Scharnitz and B2 to Mittenwald/Garmisch is VIGNETTE-FREE – take the Zirl exit carefully. Garmisch/Füssen have NO Umweltzone (Bavaria: only München, Augsburg, Regensburg, Neu-Ulm), so no green sticker needed
places.goodToKnow: Buy the 1-Tages-Vignette online at asfinag.at (activates immediately, plate-linked) if you use A13/A12; toll-free alternative from the Brenner is the B182 → Innsbruck → B171 → Zirl → B177. Saturday to Zurich via Füssen–A7–Lindau–A96 stays in Germany until the Swiss border (Swiss vignette CHF 40 needed on Swiss motorways) · Location needs verification
